title: Optimal Colorings for Discrepancy of APs

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Added 10 proved infrastructure theorems (apSum properties, alternating coloring validity, triangle inequality). Fixed pre-existing import errors. Docker build clean.
builtItems: apSum_zero, apSum_one, apSum_succ: basic recursion for AP sums
insights: Alternating coloring optimal for d=1 but terrible for d=2
Gap between d^{1/2} and d^{1+ε} is fundamental
Rudin-Shapiro achieves O(sqrt(N) log N) for all d simultaneously
alternating_d1_bound proved via pair cancellation: consecutive (-1)^n terms sum to zero, so by strong induction reducing k by 2, we only need k=0 (sum=0) and k=1 (sum=(-1)^a, natAbs=1)
Example had wrong value: apPartialSum alternating 0 1 3 = 1, not -1 (1+(-1)+1=1)
sSup/sInf on ℕ is problematic for unbounded sets — discrepancy definition returns 0 for the all-1s coloring
Fixed pre-existing build errors: Real.sqrt and Nat.factorial need heavier imports
